integrity: The upper bounds are explicit Kripke models and the IS4 lower bound exhausts the two possible one-world valuations. No numerical search, sampling argument, external certification, or independence claim is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the exact minimum countermodel size for one formula from Example 2.6. It is not a general small-model bound, does not analyze the output size of the decision procedure, and does not claim an exact complexity consequence.
title: Reflexivity changes the exact minimum countermodel size in the IS4 loop example
